# Banner

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

media and display · tier 2 · beta · renders on the server, with only its interactive part in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For one message the whole page should see: a release, a trial ending, planned maintenance.
Put it above the header; it is in the page flow, so it pushes the page down and covers nothing.

```tsx
<Banner tone="info" aria-label="Release announcement" icon={<Svg icon={bell} size="xs" />}
  action={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" tone="info" render={<a href="/changelog" />}>Read more</Button>}>
  Version 2 is out.
</Banner>
```

**A name is required.** A banner is a `region` landmark, so pass `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`; the type refuses a Banner with neither, and two banners on a page need
two names. The generated table below cannot say "one of two", which is why it is said here.

**Narrow screens.** When the message and the action do not fit on one line, the action moves under the message.

**A link action is a `Button`** with `render={<a href="..." />}`, as above. A bare `<a>` gets no styling and no 44 px touch target.

**Pass an icon when the tone matters.** Colour alone does not tell a warning from a notice.

**Wrapping it.** `Omit<BannerProps, 'tone'>` drops the name rule and the id rule; add them back with `Omit<BannerProps, 'tone'> & BannerName & BannerDismissal`.

## Dismissal

```tsx
<Banner dismissible id="release-v2" tone="info" aria-label="Release announcement">
  Version 2 is out.
</Banner>
```

- **Works from a Server Component.** `dismissible` and `id` are plain values, so a server page needs no client wrapper. Only a dismissible banner renders the client part; a plain one stays server HTML.
- **Remembered per `id`**, in `localStorage` under `tc-banner-dismissed:<id>`. Change the id when the message changes. The type requires an `id` with `dismissible`; it is also the element's id.
- **Blocked storage** (a private window, a full quota): the x still hides the banner, for this page only.
- **`onDismiss`** is a function, so only a `'use client'` file can pass it. It is called once, after the banner is hidden.
- **The next page shows it until the script runs.** The server cannot read `localStorage`, so the HTML has the banner and hydration removes it: the page below moves up by its height (120 px for the demo at 390 px). Off by default for that reason.
- **Focus.** The x leaves with the banner, so focus falls to `<body>`; in Chromium the next Tab goes on from where the banner was. To put focus somewhere, move it in `onDismiss`.
- **The x** sits at the inline end of the line it wraps to: 24 px, 44 px on a touch screen. Under forced colours a hovered x draws an outline.

**Not built:** `sticky`, `placement`, `variant`.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Banner } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Required: `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, `id` when `dismissible`. Every other prop below is optional.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-label` | **yes**, or `aria-labelledby` | `string` | - | The name of the landmark, such as "Release announcement". |
| `aria-labelledby` | **yes**, or `aria-label` | `string` | - | The id of the visible text that names the landmark. |
| `id` | **yes** when `dismissible` | `string` | - | The key the dismissal is remembered under, and the element's id. Required with `dismissible`. |
| `action` | no | `ReactNode` | - | The caller's link or Button, after the message. |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | - | The message: a sentence that wraps and is never cut. |
| `dismissible` | no | `boolean` | `false` | Adds an x that hides the banner and remembers it in this browser. Requires `id`. |
| `icon` | no | `ReactNode` | - | Shown before the message, such as a 16 px Svg. Leave it out for none. |
| `onDismiss` | no | `(() => void)` | - | Called once when the x is pressed. A function, so only a client caller can pass it. |
| `tone` | no | `primary` \| `neutral` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `danger` \| `info` | `"primary"` | What the message means, which picks the soft fill and the text colour on it. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
